rows.grounds: absolutive of pūj expressing prior act of worship
numeral quantity indicating count of repetitions
absolutive of jap expressing prior act of mantra repetition
compound denoting one who has a hundred women as wives; final nominative form
optative expressing potential attainment or result

items.question: What attainment follows from worship and ten-thousandfold mantra repetition?
premises: Worship is performed prior to mantra repetition.
The mantra is repeated ten thousand times.
Such ritual acts yield a specific personal attainment.
items.inference: Performing worship and ten-thousandfold repetition leads to becoming the husband of a hundred women.
uncertainties: Whether śata+yoṣā+patir is meant literally or as a hyperbolic expression of prosperity is not specified.
items.plain_english: Having worshipped and repeated the mantra ten thousand times, one may become the husband of a hundred women.
